jualBeliUntungRugi.q1: A bag seller bought a backpack for Rp150,000.00. He then sold it to a customer for Rp180,000.00. Calculate the profit in rupiah. Also express the profit as a percentage.

jualBeliUntungRugi.q6: Kak Rina bought a folding table for Rp350,000.00 when she first started college. After graduating and having to move cities, she was forced to sell the second-hand folding table for Rp245,000.00. How much depreciation (loss) in rupiah did Kak Rina experience? Also express the loss as a percentage!
jualBeliUntungRugi.q7: Pak Rendi was forced to sell his smartphone because he urgently needed funds. He sold the phone for Rp1,600,000.00. From the sale, Pak Rendi had to absorb a loss of 20% of his original cost. What was the original purchase price of the phone?
jualBeliUntungRugi.q8: Deni bought a second-hand mountain bike at a flea market for Rp450,000.00. Because its condition was not ideal, Deni took it to a repair shop and spent Rp150,000.00 replacing the worn chain and tyres. After the bike was back in good shape, Deni sold it to a classmate and managed to make a 25% profit. What was the selling price of the bicycle in rupiah?
jualBeliUntungRugi.q9: Mrs. Tari bought 100 kg of mangoes from a farmer for a total price of Rp1,500,000.00. After sorting, 10 kg of mangoes were found to be rotten and completely unsellable. What is the percentage of total additional cost that Pak Johan must bear if he chooses the credit option compared to buying it in cash?
